europe_now.title: Russian Radar Installation in Kaliningrad Causes NATO Concern
europe_now.summary: Germany's Deutsche Welle reported that a large new radar system built by Russia in Kaliningrad has raised security alarms within NATO. The installation adds to regional tensions amid ongoing geopolitical friction.
